main.author: Felipe R. Monteiro <felisous@amazon.com>
main.message:
Upgrade Rust toolchain to nightly-2026-11-18 (#5188)

Upgrades the toolchain from `nightly-2026-11-12` to
`nightly-2026-11-18`. All the changes below came with
`nightly-2026-11-17`; `nightly-2026-11-18` needed none.

### Changes for the new toolchain

- **Attributes.** rustc removed `Attribute::path_matches` and
`Attribute::value_str`. `attributes.rs` now checks a tool attribute's
path itself (`attr_path_matches`, the same test rustc used to do) and
reads a `path = "value"` attribute's string through `value_lit`
(`attr_value_str`).
- **Diagnostics.** `HumanReadableErrorType` gained a `no_graphics`
field.
- **View types.** rustc added `TyKind::View`, a work-in-progress feature
that rustc's own codegen and const-eval do not support yet
(`unimplemented!()`). Kani reports it as unsupported in the two type
matches in `typ.rs`, as it does for `UnsafeBinder`.
- **Float intrinsics.** `copysign`, `maximum_number_nsz` and
`minimum_number_nsz` are now generic over the float type, as `ceil`,
`sqrt` and others became before. They join `GENERIC_FLOAT_INTRINSICS`,
so Kani keeps its own f32/f64 models; the six tests call the generic
intrinsics.
- **SIMD types.** MIR no longer allows field projections into
`#[repr(simd)]` types (MCP#838). The derived `Clone`/`Debug` of the
`CustomMask` test model in `library/kani` projected into its field and
made clippy hit an ICE in MIR validation; it now copies the whole value.
All SIMD tests in the regression pass unchanged.
- **Feature gates.** `pattern_type_macro` was removed; `pattern_type!`
is gated by `pattern_types`. Four tests drop the old gate (a comment
keeps the line numbers their expected output refers to).
- **Clippy.** Nine `.contains(&"...".to_string())` calls flagged by the
new `unnecessary_to_owned` finding use `.iter().any(..)`.

### Removing `chrono`

[RUSTSEC-2026-0543](https://rustsec.org/advisories/RUSTSEC-2026-0543)
(issued 2026-11-17) marks `chrono` as unmaintained, with no fixed
version, so `cargo deny` fails on every PR and on `main`. `kani-driver`
only used it to stamp the flamegraph file name in developer mode; that
timestamp is now built from `std::time::SystemTime` (in UTC), with a
unit test. This removes `chrono` and its time-zone crates from
`Cargo.lock`.

### Testing

On Linux with CBMC 6.11.0, in the Kani CI image:
- `cargo build-dev`, the LLBC build, `scripts/kani-fmt.sh --check`, and
both clippy commands of the format-check workflow pass.
- `scripts/kani-regression.sh`: every suite passes except
`script-based-pre/compiler_defaults` (needs `jq`) and
`script-based-pre/cbmc_truncated_results` (memory limit), which only
fail in my container; the steps after the suites
(`codegen-firecracker.sh`, the `cargo-features-flag` check, the `-D
warnings` build) pass.
- `scripts/kani-llbc-regression.sh` passes.
- `cargo deny --all-features --workspace check -s` (the arguments of the
Cargo Deny workflow) passes.

All of the above was run on `nightly-2026-11-18`.

Resolves #5189 (the automatic upgrade to `nightly-2026-11-13` failed on
the attribute API change from rust-lang/rust#165871, which this PR
handles).
